verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth documents enterprise Single Sign-On via SAML 2.0, and a community user describes using its SAML SSO for multi-tenant SSO. That supports SSO connections, but the pack does not show how they map to individual customer organizations. Nothing in the evidence covers domain verification or just-in-time user provisioning. Missing for 10: documented per-organization SSO connections, verified-domain routing/ownership checks, just-in-time provisioning behavior, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can give each customer organization its own SSO connection with verified domains and just-in-time provisioning

citations.quote: Add Single Sign-On for enterprise applications with SAML 2.0.
A user new to implementing multi-tenant SSO was excited about Supabase's SAML SSO.
